fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The error message, or null if there was no error.

fields.name: AuthBytes
fields.about: The SASL authentication bytes from the server, as defined by the SASL mechanism.

fields.name: SessionLifetimeMs
fields.about: Number of milliseconds after which only re-authentication over the existing connection to create a new session can occur.
